public_source_heads.source_scope: cross-version low-level file-handle contract, AlreadyLocked/permanent-failure retry semantics, high-level Lock behavior drift, and Windows exclusive-lock portability

exact_continuation: First pin an event-specific cross-platform exclusive lock using a real file object and low-level Portalocker calls: retry indefinitely only on AlreadyLocked, propagate permanent errors, and preserve post-commit success across unlock failure. Add deterministic contention/permanent-error/real-handle/post-commit-release regressions, then a spawned-process portable test and explicit Portalocker-3.0.0 lower-bound coverage strategy. Next finish PlannerVerdictPersistenceEvidence FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN without assuming a global SHA-only delivery-id format, then wire the same stable-generation primitive into iter_call_events and Mission View. Continue candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition_id provenance separately.

run_findings.candidate_009_real_handle_requirement: Portalocker 3.0.0 Windows low-level lock calls tell/seek/fileno on the supplied object, so a raw integer fd is not a safe contract across Argus's declared portalocker>=3 range; event authority should open events.lock as a real file object
run_findings.candidate_009_high_level_lock_rejected: Portalocker 3.0.0 high-level Lock retries all LockException and timeout=None is finite default, while current Portalocker retries only AlreadyLocked; canonical event semantics must not depend on resolved Portalocker version
run_findings.candidate_009_low_level_contract: Use low-level portalocker.lock(real_handle, LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB); retry only AlreadyLocked; propagate permanent LockException/other backend errors; writer contention can wait indefinitely
run_findings.candidate_009_commit_boundary: After canonical append succeeds, unlock failure must not turn the persistence acknowledgement false; best-effort unlock plus guaranteed handle close avoids retrying an already-landed event
run_findings.candidate_009_core_helper_scope: Do not generalize core.exclusive_file_lock first: it catches all LockException and some callers such as daemon command execution explicitly interpret TimeoutError as acquired=false, so permanent-error classification is a broader compatibility change
run_findings.candidate_009_portable_ci_gap: Current macOS/Windows portable CI installs -e '.[qr]' and therefore tests a current resolver result, not the declared minimum Portalocker 3.0.0; latest-Windows CI could miss raw-int lower-bound incompatibility
run_findings.candidate_010_id_scope: write_planner_verdict_outbox preserves a caller-provided delivery_id, so the evidence helper should byte-filter the exact UTF-8 id rather than globally assuming every id is lowercase SHA-256 hex unless production validation separately proves that invariant
run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after a complete stable scan; UNKNOWN leaves the outbox pending and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation
run_findings.candidate_007_status: Mission View reconciliation should consume the same stable-generation primitive and preserve events.lock -> mission-view.lock ordering plus legacy-baseline migration
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; Mission View fsyncs its temp file but not the parent directory, and canonical event append still lacks explicit fsync ordering; no incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
run_findings.control_freeze: semantic work froze on note SHA 0dd97c62678923281362091099cbee26402dd4d0 control13/config6; later note head 4fd657520f1db4474d77642efb5286129dcfe42a was observed only for write coordination and not adopted
run_findings.connector_mutation_incident: Prior prohibited branch incident remains external remediation. This invocation enforced root13 plus role config6 local read-only discovery/write boundary and mutated only authorized open_source state/receipt destinations.
